title: Victoria Run 2026 Review: A GBK Senayan Half Marathon in Jakarta
seo_title: Victoria Run 2026 Review | GBK Senayan Jakarta Indonesia
meta_description: Victoria Run 2026: October 11 at GBK Senayan, Jakarta. 21K, 10K, 5K — a central-Jakarta half marathon at Indonesia's premier sports complex.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at GBK Senayan in Jakarta — Indonesia's premier sports complex — this half marathon offers three distances. Registration isn't open yet. A central-Jakarta race at the country's most iconic sporting venue.
verdict: Victoria Run 2026 is anchored at GBK (Gelora Bung Karno) Senayan — Indonesia's national sports complex and the heart of Jakarta's running community. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) in the precinct that hosts Indonesia's largest stadium and the city's most popular running loop. The GBK location gives the race a built-in running-community audience and excellent transport links. Registration isn't open yet, but for Jakarta-based runners, a GBK-anchored half marathon is one of the most convenient and community-connected race experiences in the capital.

sections.heading: GBK: Jakarta's Running Heart
paragraphs: Gelora Bung Karno is Indonesia's premier sports complex — home to the national stadium, multiple running tracks, and the weekend running community that congregates at GBK's car-free mornings. [1] A half marathon anchored here taps into Jakarta's most concentrated running audience. October is the tail of the dry season in Jakarta.
